name: Custom OAI-compatible Endpoints
description: Canonical reference provider plugin: OpenAI-compatible chat completions over any HTTP endpoint (vLLM, LM Studio, Ollama, llama.cpp, self-hosted). Dynamically claims each configured custom endpoint prefix from providers.custom / SPORE_PROVIDER_<NAME>_* so model routes use prefix/model-id. Other provider plugins (openai-provider, openrouter-provider) wrap the same OAICompatClient via this plugin's lib.
